title: Two Rooks on Two Ranks
setup: Black's king is on f7 with a rook on h6 and a bishop on a2, and your rooks command the third and fourth ranks.
hint: The king's only safe squares are ahead of it. Work out where it ends up after two checks, and put a piece there first.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qa7+}} drives it to e6, {{Ra6+}} to d5, and {{Qd4#}} is waiting. The rooks never capture anything — they exist to take away ranks, and the queen collects.
